entry.title: 'Tiny Chef Show' “saved” after viral cancellation and fundraising efforts as creators confirm return
entry.summary: After Nickelodeon quietly axed Tiny Chef Show in June, a viral clip of the little chef bawling on a phone call lit up social media—and spurred a massive crowdfunding drive. Fans flooded the creators’ website and joined the “Fan Cwub,” raising enough dough to keep production rolling, even if a new TV deal hasn’t materialized yet. In an Instagram post, the team announced they’re dusting off the tiny cameras in Chef’s tree stump home and thanked everyone for the “outpouring of love messages, fan art, and donations.” Details on episode length or release date are still TBD, but Tiny Chef’s next adventure is officially on the menu.

entry.title: "That's Some Real Coward S***" - Hideki Kamiya Discusses The Fallout From The Bayonetta 3 Voiceover Controversy
entry.summary: Hideki Kamiya has broken his silence on the Bayonetta 3 voice-over kerfuffle, not to rehash the pay-dispute that saw Hellena Taylor swapped out for Jennifer Hale, but to call out the torrent of abuse he copped online. In a new video he reveals how even “famous people” piled in with snarky tweets—then quietly deleted them when the dust settled—labeling that behaviour “coward s***” and demanding honest, public apologies if you’re wrong. Despite the drama, Bayonetta 3 launched to rave reviews, and Kamiya’s already moved on, exiting PlatinumGames to team up with Capcom on an Okami sequel—leaving the future of our favourite witch firmly in the hands of Nintendo (and maybe a bit of Hale’s magic).

entry.title: Bethesda is allegedly working on ‘multiple Fallout games', including Fallout 3 Remastered, teases report
entry.summary: Bethesda’s got more than just Elder Scrolls 6 on the stove—they’re rumored to be juggling “multiple Fallout projects,” including a Fallout 3 Remastered (thanks to a collab with Virtuous). Starfield’s behind them, the next Elder Scrolls is in early dev, and according to VGC’s Jordan Middler on the Friends Per Second podcast, Fallout is the big focus for Xbox moving forward. Though details are thin, fans are buzzing about everything from Fallout New Vegas 2 to a Fallout 2 remake or even a full Fallout 5, all at various dev stages. With Microsoft owning both Bethesda and Obsidian, some much-desired cross-studio magic could be on the horizon—if both teams are up for it.

entry.title: Stardew Valley just became the highest-rated Steam game of all time 9 years after release, and it deserves it
entry.summary: Stardew Valley, ConcernedApe’s charming farming sim, has just claimed the #1 spot on Steam250’s all-time rankings, dethroning Portal 2 after 14 years. With an 8.87 score and 98% positive feedback across almost 900,000 reviews, it edges out Portal 2 (99% positive, ~437K votes) and Terraria (97% positive, ~1.42M votes). Even though Eric Barone has paused updates to focus on Haunted Chocolatier, the game thrives on fan-made mods and expansions. Its enduring popularity and overwhelming community love prove that this cozy indie masterpiece still reigns supreme on Steam.

entry.title: Forza Motorsport Series Is Reportedly Cancelled After Xbox Laid Off 50% Of Studio
entry.summary: Turn 10—the team behind the Forza Motorsport series—has quietly been shifted into a support role for Playground Games’ Forza Horizon franchise, according to a former employee’s post on ResetERA. After laying off over 70 staffers, the studio has “shuttered” its Motorsport division and now lends its expertise to Horizon instead of working on new Motorsport titles. This shake-up comes amid a broader wave of Microsoft gaming cutbacks: Perfect Dark’s Initiative studio was shuttered, Rare’s Everwild got canned, a ZeniMax Online MMORPG and a Romero Games FPS were axed, and several other high-profile projects have been quietly killed off. Fans hoping for another Forza Motorsport reboot may have to wait a while.
